Kellbrook Ridge walk

Getting started

Park at the village hall in Kellbrook and follow the lane north past the church. The path is rough in places, so take your time and watch your footing. Most walkers stop here for a drink and a look back at the valley. In wet weather the grass gets slippery, and the stones even more so. Sheep graze on the slopes all year; keep dogs on a lead. The views open up to the west, over the patchwork of fields below. There is little shelter on this stretch, so pack a warm layer. A few cairns mark the way where the path fades into the heather.
